# ELEDEN

> Premium short-form video systems and brand strategy for businesses in Munich and worldwide, by Denys Synenko.

ELEDEN is a Munich-based studio building repeatable content systems: reels, corporate videos, creative campaigns, and brand strategy for premium services, real estate, hospitality, personal brands, and product launches.
